regime_note: The us_chain_20plus regime is why this city ranks first for capture. FDA 21 CFR 101.11 requires chains of 20+ locations to provide written nutrition information including PROTEIN on request. That is a number the phe estimator can use directly, and it does not exist in Asheville.

operators_to_capture.name: Walt Disney World Resort
operators_to_capture.accommodation_evidence: Published Special Dietary Requests page directs guests on a 'medically-restrictive diet (such as very low protein)' to email the Special Diets team for a Special Diets Request Form, no sooner than 14 days before arrival; the team then assists with dining and may give restaurants advance notice. Third-party coverage of the program lists PKU by name among requests requiring advance contact. Victoria & Albert's is handled by a separate dedicated line.
operators_to_capture.why_it_matters: A published, citable, operator-level policy naming our exact condition, covering dozens of restaurants, verifiable by READING rather than asking. Nothing in Asheville can be established this way.
operators_to_capture.caveat: Disney's own page states restaurants take reasonable efforts and cannot guarantee all requests can be met. Evidence about process, not about a plate.
operators_to_capture.ttl_rationale: A corporate policy does not turn over when a line cook quits. Annual re-check, not the 180 days used for chef-tier verification.
